For visitors

Group size is capped at 20 to 25 in the city's filing. Check the collective's channels for the route; the city's daily ride agenda lists each night's destination the morning of. A ride on Wed Sept 9 (8:15 pm) was also listed.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Rueda Libre, rodada del jueves group ride

Rueda Libre, rodada del jueves is a social group ride in Mexico City, Mexico. It rolls every Thursday at 7:45 pm local time from Casa Rueda Libre.

A Thursday-night group ride that leaves Casa Rueda Libre in Barrio San Lucas, Iztapalapa, for a different destination every week: the Basílica de Guadalupe on Sept 10, Ecatepec on Sept 17, Tlalpan on Sept 24 and Coyoacán's central plaza on Oct 1.
